description: Stores internal insurer claim history used during motor insurance claim risk and fraud assessment. This information is retrieved internally and is not uploaded by the customer.

fields.name: CustomerName
fields.description: Name of the customer whose prior insurance claim history is stored.

fields.name: PolicyNumber
fields.description: Insurance policy number associated with the claim history.

fields.name: PriorClaimCount
fields.description: Number of prior claims recorded for the customer/policy. Stored as DECIMAL with zero decimal places because UiPath Basic entity fields do not support INT.

fields.name: RecentSimilarClaimCount
fields.description: Number of recent claims with a similar collision pattern. Stored as DECIMAL with zero decimal places because UiPath Basic entity fields do not support INT.

fields.name: LastClaimDate
fields.description: Date of the most recent prior claim, if any.

fields.name: HistoryRiskNote
fields.description: Internal insurer note summarizing relevant prior claim history for risk assessment.
